scope: Original reference only: body/bones/animation/attachment interfaces. No held/accessory object asset work; no Dynasty asset selected for production. Applicable1000 not claimed.
applicability: Semiaquatic locomotion blend, coupled social state invalidation, head-root body hierarchy and attack-origin interface. Not a proposal to add social display/projectile combat to Dynasty.
creation: Entity constructor installs land MoveControl/GroundPathNavigatorWide; entering/leaving water switches movement controller and navigator. Synced display flag false, angle0,partnerUUIDempty,mouth0,command0,sittingfalse. Model64x64: root→head→eyes,tail; tail→dorsalFin,tailFin,leftFin,rightFin. No jaw bone.
business_producer: Display goal starts only when initiator is not grounded (canUse rejects onGround), adult, not following/sitting/in-love/riding/targeting, cooldown0; finds nearby compatible GROUNDED partner. Do not silently replace actual opposite ground predicates with an idealized both-grounded rule.

Pairing writes partner UUID to both entities and instantlyTriggerDisplayAI for peer. Start resets self displayTimer and angle, chooses opposite directions. Tick raises display flag; closes distance or circles midpoint, alternates angle +/-180 in10degree steps, navigates and turns entity yaw.

At distance<0.8 with both grounded it opens mouth10..29ticks and gives partner velocity. Timer>400 or vertical separation>2 in near-distance branch stops both navigation, assigns cooldown200..399 and calls stop. Timer does not progress in distXZ>3 chase branch.

Continuation requires adult, not follow/sit/in-love/vehicle, no target, partner exists+alive, both cooldown0. Not all initial guards are repeated (e.g. passenger). stop clears center,self/partner flags and UUID,timers,angle; self navigation stops. Partner navigation only explicitly stopped in timeout branch, not generic stop.

Attack goal line-of-sight+distance<8+cooldown0 constructs MudBall and launches before openMouth10. It strafes back when close, otherwise follows; stop clears shootCooldown/strafe boolean but does not explicitly zero MoveControl strafe. Do not claim full controller reset.
entity_consumer: Each tick saves previous swim/sit/display/mud progress. display and sit ramp0..5 by1; swim condition !onGround&&inWaterOrBubble ramps0..5; onMud reads actual block below and raises model offset0..1 by0.5.

Server increments/decrements swimTimer; water entry requested after1000landticks or hurt, suppressed while displaying; leave requested after200waterticks or display. Underlying semiaquatic goals/controllers not read this batch.
Mouth ticks decremented to0 by tick; same mouth state can be produced by display, attack,hurt,taming,feeding. No timed jaw contact in model.
Server moves DISPLAY_ANGLE +/-1 toward nextDisplayAngleFromServer. Neither reviewed ModelMudskipper nor RenderMudskipper reads this angle. It cannot be credited as a bone orientation consumer.
transform_consumer: setupAnim resets default pose then partial-interpolates display/swim/sit/mud. Mud correction headY-2 follows actual below-block flag, not bone collision.
Display tilts head-10deg,tail20deg,dorsal-10deg,tailfin10deg,fin-10deg plus positions and age-based sway; dorsal lowered2 when not displaying. Sitting adds distinct tail/fin poses.

Movement amplitude split walk=limbSwingAmount*(1-.2*swimProgress),swim=limbSwingAmount*.2*swimProgress. Head/tail/tailFin phased swings,fin flaps and landhead vertical/foreaft motion. All child transforms inherit head root; no chain point simulation.

renderToBuffer juvenile head scale1.45 with shouldScaleChildren=true and global0.5, then explicitly restores headscale1; adult also forces1. Flag shouldScaleChildren not explicitly restored but scale reset. No adult/child transition runtime proof.
render_and_interface: Renderer binds actual model and uses spit PNG only while mouthticks>0. MudBall spawn origin = entity.position + yaw-rotated(0,0,0.2*scale), not tracked mouth bone or eye height. MudBall damping0.9 and gravity-0.06; hit delegates unread EntityMobProjectile before slowdown. Producer origin read only; no projectile/handheld asset制作.
stop_reload_invalid: Display progress decays5ticks after flagfalse; mouth independently expires. stop DOES NOT reset synced displayAngle or nextDisplayAngleFromServer, so residual angle data remains; reviewed model does not consume it.

NBT saves FromBucket,DisplayCooldown,command,sitting and super. Transient displayflag,partnerUUID,displayTimer,displayangle,mouthticks,swimtimer and progress not explicitly saved; fresh object defaults. Bucket roundtrip invokes same save/read methods; mid-display continuity not promised.

Target arrival/partner death invalidates continuation; local shared pair interactions and goal selector ordering require runtime. No explicit teleport/death chain cleanup in whole entity; no late-observer exact-phase guarantee.
No jaw animation, per-node terrain collision or actual PNG inspection. Citadel default-pose/progress helpers, native MobRenderer and EntityMobProjectile consumers remain dependency gaps.
counting: At most one family candidate, not six references. Projectile is supplemental origin evidence, not separately counted. Independent acceptance/newcredit0.
